nodes.description: Mapping address=>uint256 storing user deposits in PERSONAL_BANK.
Minimum balance threshold (1 ether) required before Collect succeeds.
External LogFile contract reference used for event logging; settable by anyone before initialization.
Boolean initialization latch guarding SetMinSum and SetLogFile.
Public function that sets MinSum before initialization; unchecked privilege-sensitive setter.
Public function that sets the external Log contract address before initialization.
Public function that flips intitalized to true, locking the configuration setters.
Payable function crediting balances[msg.sender] with msg.value and logging via Log.AddMessage.
Payable withdrawal function that performs an external call to msg.sender before decrementing its balance.
Payable fallback function that forwards all value transfers to Deposit().
LogFile function writing sender, value, data and timestamp into LastMsg and History.
Caller-controlled address used as balance key, call target and log argument.
Block timestamp (now) used as LastMsg.Time, allowing miner influence.
msg.sender.call.value(_am)() low-level value call executed before the caller balance is decremented.
balances[msg.sender]+= msg.value arithmetic update in Deposit.
balances[msg.sender]-=_am arithmetic update in Collect, performed after the external call.
External call Log.AddMessage() to a user-controlled contract address with return value ignored.
Parameter _val of SetMinSum used to overwrite MinSum.
Parameter _log of SetLogFile used to overwrite the external Log pointer.
Parameter _am of Collect controlling the amount sent in the external value call.
Parameter _adr of AddMessage stored as LastMsg.Sender.
Parameter _val of AddMessage stored as LastMsg.Val.
Parameter _data of AddMessage stored as LastMsg.Data.
LogFile Message array that accumulates every pushed LastMsg entry.
LogFile struct holding the most recent sender, timestamp, value and data.

edges.reason: The intitalized latch gates SetMinSum, so the first caller can seize configuration.
The intitalized latch gates SetLogFile, so the first caller can point Log at an arbitrary contract.
Initialized() writes intitalized=true, irreversibly locking the setters.
The payable fallback forwards execution to Deposit().
Untrusted msg.sender indexes the balance mapping credited with msg.value.
Deposit mutates the balances state variable.
Untrusted msg.sender indexes the balance mapping decremented by _am.
Collect mutates the balances state variable after the external call.
Untrusted msg.sender is the target of the low-level value call.
Caller-supplied _am is forwarded as value in the external call.
MinSum is read in the Collect guard condition.
balances[msg.sender] is read in the Collect guard condition.
The external value call can re-enter Collect while the balance is still un-decremented.
_val is written into the MinSum state variable.
_log is written into the Log state variable via LogFile(_log).
Deposit invokes the external Log.AddMessage call.
Collect invokes the external Log.AddMessage call after withdrawal.
The user-controlled Log address is the target of the AddMessage external call.
_adr is stored into LastMsg.Sender.
_val is stored into LastMsg.Val.
_data is stored into LastMsg.Data.
Block timestamp is stored into LastMsg.Time, creating a miner-influenceable timestamp dependency.
LastMsg is pushed into the History array.
AddMessage appends to the History state variable.
AddMessage writes the LastMsg state variable.

normalization_plan.reason: _val exists only to be assigned to MinSum inside SetMinSum.
_log exists only to be cast and assigned to Log inside SetLogFile.
_am is only used by Collect to gate the guard and size the external value call.
_adr is only consumed by AddMessage when writing LastMsg.Sender.
_val is only consumed by AddMessage when writing LastMsg.Val.
_data is only consumed by AddMessage when writing LastMsg.Data.
